title: Final Answer Requirement
description: Essential Criteria: Provide the correct inequality for F/f or R based on the given parameters.

title: Understanding Divergence
description: Important Criteria: Explain how aperture diffraction affects the angular divergence of a beam.

title: Use of Equations
description: Important Criteria: Correctly apply the equations for angular divergence from both the lens and mirror systems.

title: Parameter Relationships
description: Important Criteria: Discuss the relationship between the focal lengths and radii of the lenses and mirrors in reducing divergence.

title: Units and Constants
description: Optional Criteria: Include appropriate units and constants used in calculations, such as the wavelength of the laser.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Watch for sign mistakes or incorrect application of the diffraction limit formula.

title: Beam Expansion Explanation
description: Optional Criteria: Describe how expanding the beam cross-section contributes to reduced divergence.
